svg.text: =ASRS1 AS/RS one aisle (VC20 + Roots combined FMS)
DESIGN - to be checked and released by a qualified engineer
IEC 60617 symbols (simplified), IEC 81346-2 tags, columns = current paths
2 channels each, cross-circuit detection by test pulses
-TA11 travel -TA13 hoist -TA14 fork (STO, SS1, SLS, SBC)
E-stop: SS1 (ramp 0.5 s) -> STO + -QA2 off after 1 s
Safety functions (program): SF1 PLr d -> PL d OK; SF2 PLr d -> PL d OK; SF3 PLr d -> PL d OK; SF4 PLr d -> PL d OK; SF5 PLr d -> PL d OK; SF6 PLr c -> PL c OK; SF7 PLr d -> PL d OK
